message.content: In the conversation regarding Red Dead Redemption 2, Jareth shared his thoughts on the game's immersive storytelling and character development. Specifically, Jareth mentioned spending time helping the townsfolk, which he found particularly moving. This side mission showcased Arthur's transformation and allowed Jareth to feel more connected to Arthur's character and the world. He described how this side mission with the "troubled" horse helped highlight Arthur's growth and empathy, emphasizing the importance of these small moments in creating a richer narrative. This kind of interaction and character development resonated deeply with Jareth, contributing to his enjoyment and emotional investment in the game.
